question: Under which theme was World Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy Day observed on 7th September 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Family: The Heart of Care.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **World Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy Day 2025 was observed under the theme "Family: The Heart of Care".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The theme "Family: The Heart of Care" emphasizes the critical role families play in the care and support of individuals with Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy (DMD).**
 
• The **Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD)** coordinated various awareness programs across India for DMD education.
 
• DMD is a progressive disorder affecting children, impairing mobility, breathing, and heart functions, requiring timely intervention and awareness.
 
• Programs included webinars and community events, promoting social inclusion and offering support to families affected by DMD.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy (DMD)__

 __
 
• A rare genetic disorder that causes progressive muscle weakness, primarily affecting boys and leading to severe physical limitations.
 
 
 
• DEPwD__
 __
 
• Works under the Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, focusing on the empowerment of persons with disabilities.
 
 
 
• Indian Sign Language Research and Training Centre (ISLRTC)__
 
 
• Provides education and training related to Indian Sign Language and promotes inclusivity for persons with disabilities.
